Near the first resonance the transmission is a Lorentzian,
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{1}{1+x^2}, \qquad x \equiv \frac{\omega-\epsilon_1}{\Gamma_1} .
\label{eq:t1}
\end{equation}
Near the second resonance it has the same shape,
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{1}{x^2+1}, \qquad x \equiv \frac{\omega-\epsilon_2}{\Gamma_2} .
\label{eq:t2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
